Before writing this up, read the hard rules in
[kis/knowledge/rules.md](https://github.com/smkamranqadri/tartib/blob/main/kis/knowledge/rules.md).
Tags, projects, multiple users, streaks, charts or a fourth thing that pushes are declined on
principle. An exception to a rule has to be argued on that rule's own terms.

What you were trying to do, and what got in the way.

**What you propose**

**Which rule it touches, if any, and why the exception is worth it**
